purpose: Part 1/2 of verified hard-tail 5-record item effect batch 025; together these files contain exactly 5 self-contained reviewed records.

items/rod-negation-132.name: Rod of Negation
items/rod-negation-132.effectSummary: Three times per day, the wielder can fire a ray at a magic item with a ranged touch attack. The ray functions like greater dispel magic using caster level 15, but affects only the spell or spell-like functions of magic items; the item receives no saving throw and artifacts cannot be negated. Negating an instantaneous item effect requires the wielder to have readied the action.

items/ring-spell-storing-88.name: Ring of Spell Storing
items/ring-spell-storing-88.effectSummary: The ring stores up to five total spell levels. The wearer can cast stored spells at the minimum caster level required for each spell without providing material components, a focus, XP, or suffering arcane spell failure; activation uses the spell's normal casting time with a minimum of one standard action. A spellcaster or scroll can load spells into the ring up to the five-level limit, with metamagic spells using their adjusted spell level. The ring magically tells its wearer the names of all spells currently stored.

items/ehlonnas-seed-pouch-relic-386.name: Ehlonnas Seed Pouch [Relic]
items/ehlonnas-seed-pouch-relic-386.effectSummary: For a neutral-good, lawful-good, chaotic-good, or neutral wearer, the pouch contains three acorns each morning that function as goodberries. With the relic connection to Ehlonna, an acorn thrown up to 100 feet can instead create one chosen effect: a treant as changestaff for 1 hour in a space large enough to hold it, a wall of thorns where the acorn lands, or a splash-weapon fire-seeds effect dealing 11d6 fire damage on impact without splitting the damage among multiple acorns.
